# CG-REQ-030: Request property removed from open schema

A property was removed from a request schema that still allows additional properties.

**Why it matters:** In an open schema the removed property becomes unconstrained.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.propertyRemoved` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Property "{property}" is no longer documented in {where}.
>
> The schema is open, so the property is still accepted; the provider may now ignore it.
>
> **Fix:** Confirm that consumers do not rely on what the property controlled.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: open schema drops legacyId

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {}, legacyId: {}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. Property "legacyId" is no longer documented in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Does not fire: closed schema

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {a: {}, b: {}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, additionalProperties: false, properties: {a: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Server-side semantics for undocumented fields are unknown.

```yaml

      expires: 2027-01-01         # optional
```
